cd /workspace/tmp/t && cat > t1.py <<'EOF'
from run import *

# 1. empty request
print(run({"version":1,"traces":[]}))
print(run({"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"x","config":cfg(),"events":[]}]}))

# 2. invalid inputs
bad = [
 ("dup key", b'{"version":1,"version":1,"traces":[]}'),
 ("trailing", b'{"version":1,"traces":[]} {}'),
 ("nan", b'{"version":1,"traces":[]}'),
 ("not object", b'[]'),
 ("bad version", json.dumps({"version":2,"traces":[]}).encode()),
 ("float", json.dumps({"version":1.0,"traces":[]}).encode()),
 ("bool as int", json.dumps({"version":True,"traces":[]}).encode()),
 ("unknown root key", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[],"x":1}).encode()),
 ("missing key", json.dumps({"version":1}).encode()),
 ("dup trace id", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[]),trace("a",[])]}).encode()),
 ("bad trace id", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a b",[])]}).encode()),
 ("trace id too long", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a"*33,[])]}).encode()),
 ("bad op", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[{"t":0,"op":"nope"}])]}).encode()),
 ("time backwards", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[{"t":5,"op":"tick"},{"t":4,"op":"tick"}])]}).encode()),
 ("bad level", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"X","action":"install"}])]}).encode()),
 ("bad action", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"H","action":"drop"}])]}).encode()),
 ("empty packets", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[dg(0,[])])]}).encode()),
 ("17 packets", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[dg(0,[pk("I",i,[]) for i in range(17)])])]}).encode()),
 ("65 frames", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[dg(0,[pk("I",0,[{"type":"PING"}]*65])])]}).encode()),
 ("unknown frame type", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[dg(0,[pk("I",0,[{"type":"FOO"}])])])]}).encode()),
 ("uppercase hex", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[dg(0,[pk("I",0,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"AA"}])])])]}).encode()),
 ("odd hex", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[dg(0,[pk("I",0,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"a"}])])])]}).encode()),
 ("extra frame key", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[dg(0,[pk("I",0,[{"type":"PING","x":1}])])])]}).encode()),
 ("bad sent range reversed", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[],sent={"I":[[5,1]],"H":[],"A":[]})]}).encode()),
 ("bad sent adjacent", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[],sent={"I":[[1,5],[6,9]],"H":[],"A":[]})]}).encode()),
 ("bad sent overlap", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[],sent={"I":[[1,5],[3,9]],"H":[],"A":[]})]}).encode()),
 ("sent 33 ranges", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[],sent={"I":[[2*i,2*i]] for i in range(33)],"H":[],"A":[]})]}).encode()),
 ("config unknown key", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"a","config":dict(cfg(),zz=1),"events":[]}]}).encode()),
 ("negative t", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[{"t":-1,"op":"tick"}])]}).encode()),
 ("t too big", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[{"t":10**13,"op":"tick"}])]}).encode()),
 ("bool for int field", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"a","config":dict(cfg(),idle_ms=True),"events":[]}]}).encode()),
 ("stream id float", json.dumps({"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[dg(0,[pk("A",0,[{"type":"STREAM","id":1.0,"offset":0,"data_hex":"","fin":False}])])])]}).encode()),
 ("invalid utf8", b'{"version":1,"traces":[]}\xff'),
 ("empty input", b''),
 ("whitespace only", b'   '),
]
for name, raw in bad:
    out = run(None, raw)
    print(("OK  " if out == {"error":"INVALID_INPUT"} else "FAIL"), name, out if out!={"error":"INVALID_INPUT"} else "")

python3 t1.py
